verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's core isolation unit is the namespace. The docs show namespaces as isolated units (per-test isolated namespaces), listable by prefix, warmable per namespace, and pinnable for reserved compute. Cheapness comes from the object-storage-first design, and one limit is documented: a sharded namespace scales to 256TB. missing for 10: an explicit namespace-per-tenant multi-tenancy guide, documented limits on namespace count or per-tenant overhead, per-namespace cost figures, and independent corroboration of running many tenants at scale.
